body: The provided generator greedily excludes radius-two Hamming neighbors and filters GC/triples. The actual saved strings were independently parsed and checked directly, without running the generator or relying on its forbidden bitmap. Full library and generator/checker are source routes. No optimal code-size claim, indel/shifted-frame theorem, kinetic off-target discrimination or cargo-compatible controller is supplied. Unique DNA position labels would still require a working controller/strand-displacement interface and do not solve PNA donor release or alpha/eta selectivity after covalent attachment.

review.scope: Completed source-exposed intake-author reconstruction of covalent graph connectivity versus identity; renewal rebuild and independent accepted-junction purity, explicit total-product-size steric exponent and boundary-independent optimal-tree substructure; odd-fragment endpoint parity and exhaustive four-port counterconstruction; stationary two-click hazard law; independent exponential-clock Laplace/Jensen and conditional-deadline argument. The entire acquired1023-word library was independently checked over522753 unordered pairs: distinct length10 ACGT strings, min aligned Hamming3, GC4-6 and no homopolymer triple. Small exact rational checks verify model recurrence/parity/port/DP scope without executing original research programs. Correct-pair success versus acceptance and total-product versus child length are explicit qualifications, not silently blended. Three original programs were fully read, not run; missing import, numerical simulations, primary chemistry papers, measured performance, novelty and practical advantage are outside acceptance.
